ruleset_name: Marina Crest Holdings — Lease Acceptance Standards
notes: The agent must validate each extracted lease against these rules and report, for each rule, PASS / FAIL / NOT_DETERMINABLE with a short reason and (where possible) the source clause it relied on.

rules.description: Security deposit must be at least one month's rent.
Lease must contain a defined rent escalation clause (an actual mechanism or percentage, not merely 'as mutually agreed').
Fixed term must not exceed 36 months without owner approval.
Expiry date must be after the commencement date, and the stated term length must match the dates.
rules.check: expiry_date > commencement_date AND term_months == months_between(commencement_date, expiry_date)

rules.description: Both parties (landlord and tenant) must be identified and the lease must be signed by both.
rules.check: landlord.present AND tenant.present AND landlord.signed AND tenant.signed

rules.description: Annual rent must reconcile with the stated monthly rent (annual == monthly x 12).
The leased unit must exist in the owner's property/unit records and must be marked available before a new lease is linked.
rules.check: unit_id exists in units.json AND unit.status == 'available'
